{"code": "# Deduplicate the entire dataframe on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# This ensures each patient appears once, with their latest (highest sample_seq) data
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now check the control arm, moderate severity population after deduplication
control_mod_dedup = df_dedup[(df_dedup['arm'] == 'control') & (df_dedup['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Check size
n_control_mod_dedup = len(control_mod_dedup)
print(f'Control arm, moderate severity patients after deduplication: {n_control_mod_dedup}')

# Now compute the response fraction
responded_count = control_mod_dedup['responded'].sum()
response_fraction = responded_count / n_control_mod_dedup

print(f'Responded count: {responded_count}')
print(f'Response fraction: {response_fraction}')"}
